title: N+1 query pattern in ChatStore::list via unread_count
description: ChatStore::list fetches all chat rows in one query, then calls self.unread_count(&id) for each row in a Rust loop — one extra SQL query per chat. ChatStore::get and find_direct_by_contact_id have the same pattern. For N chats, this produces N+1 queries. unread_count should be inlined as a subquery or correlated expression in the main SELECT.
